findings.title: A direction icon that points the wrong way
findings.message: "solid.fa-arrow-right" is not mirrored in right-to-left. Check it points the way the reader moves.
findings.fix: Mirror it in RTL with a :dir(rtl) { transform: scaleX(-1) } rule, or swap to the opposite icon.

findings.title: Spacing that does not mirror
findings.message: margin-right: 8px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end and the other logical properties.
